source_text: Viginti argenteis venditur; ducitur in Aegyptum. Iudas consulit venditionem — umbra traditionis.
pass_a_gloss: For-twenty silver-pieces is-sold; is-led into Egypt. Judah advises sale — shadow of-betrayal.
pass_b_english: [[Sold for twenty pieces of silver; led into Egypt >> Bible:Genesis 37:28]]. Judah counsels the sale — a shadow of betrayal.
